exact_remaining_gap: Every independent concatenation of stopped standard Brownian pieces with common deterministic duration bound and divergent duration sums in both directions admits an almost surely finite random time S at which the two recentered halves are independent standard Brownian motions. S need not be a stopping time or junction; fixed-origin Brownianity is not required.
remaining_gap_qualification: Need exact finite random origin or admissible bounded counterexample excluding every such origin; coupling/scaling does not settle it.
